import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SCRIPT = ROOT / 'tools/mirror_sync/agent_guard_orphan_reconciler_v2.py'


def load_module():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('agent_guard_orphan_reconciler_v2', SCRIPT)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    assert spec.loader is not None
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def test_reconcile_exact_terminal_owners():
    module = load_module()
    result = module.reconcile(True)
    assert tuple(result['targets']) == module.TARGETS
    for item in result['targets'].values():
        assert item['active'] is False
        assert item['process_alive'] is False


def test_no_wildcard_targets():
    module = load_module()
    assert len(module.TARGETS) == 3
    assert all('*' not in value for value in module.TARGETS)
